preferences.title: Preferences

fields.confirmCloseTab: Ask before discarding unsaved changes when closing a tab

preferences.contrastHint: More draws stronger borders and secondary text.
preferences.systemTitleBarHint: Shows your desktop's title bar and window buttons instead of Gostman's own. Applies after a restart.
preferences.systemTitleBarRestart: Restart Gostman to apply this change.
preferences.systemTitleBarFailed: The setting could not be saved.
preferences.interfaceFontHint: Any font installed on this device.
preferences.codeFontHint: Editors, the address bar and other code.
preferences.fontMissing: Not found on this device, so the default font is used.
preferences.fontsSuggested: Installed fonts are suggested as you type a font name.
preferences.fontsDenied: The installed fonts could not be read.
preferences.commandDescription: Theme, colours, fonts, text size, editor, layout and defaults

methods.title: Method colours
methods.hint: The colour of each request method in the sidebar, tabs and lists. Add a background to show methods as badges.

theme.paletteHint: Each palette has a light and a dark version. Your own colours are applied on top.
theme.colorsHint: Set the background and text colour of each part of the window. Only the colours you change are kept.

previewHint.light: The window is dark now. Set the theme to Light to see these colours in place.
previewHint.dark: The window is light now. Set the theme to Dark to see these colours in place.

surfaceHints.window: Title bar, status bar and every part not listed here.
surfaceHints.body: Also gRPC messages, MCP arguments and saved examples.
surfaceHints.menu: Context menus, lists and the command palette.

theme.shareHint: A theme holds the palette, the accent colour, and your custom part and method colours for both modes.
theme.copyFailed: The theme could not be copied to the clipboard.
theme.importPlaceholder: Paste a theme copied from Gostman
theme.invalid: This is not a Gostman theme, or it has unknown parts or colours that are not written as #rrggbb.
theme.lowContrast: Text may be hard to read. Aim for at least {{minimum}}:1.

preferences.timeoutHint_one: Applies to requests that set no timeout of their own. 0 uses the built-in limit of {{count}} second.
preferences.timeoutHint_other: Applies to requests that set no timeout of their own. 0 uses the built-in limit of {{count}} seconds.
preferences.languageSwitchHint: Gostman reloads to show the new language. Open tabs and unsaved drafts are kept; responses shown in tabs are cleared.
preferences.languageHelp: Missing your language, or found a wrong translation? {{link}}.
preferences.accentAdjusted: Shown as {{light}} in light mode and {{dark}} in dark mode so text in this colour stays readable.
preferences.sidebarViewsHint: Choose which tabs the sidebar shows and in what order. Right-click the tabs in the sidebar to show or hide them there.
